note: NOURI's 10 longest-running non-offer image formats, rebuilt for DentalPULSE as top-of-funnel statics. Mouth + gut (no liver, per brief), no invented customer counts, white capsules, no price/scarcity.

concepts.headline: BAD BREATH, MOUTHWASH FIXES IT (struck through)
concepts.prompt: Clean e-commerce ad on a pure white background. Top line in small grey text with a tiny blue caduceus icon: "Doctor Recommended · 3rd Party Lab Tested in USA". Big bold black headline on two lines: "BAD BREATH," and below it "MOUTHWASH FIXES IT" with a thick red line striking through the second line. Under it in small dark text: "A daily oral probiotic that works on both sources of bad breath: the mouth and the gut." Below, the DentalPULSE jar large on the left with two white capsules in front and a soft shadow. On the right, a column of three small icons with short labels: a gold money-bag icon "90-Day Money-Back Guarantee", a blue tooth icon "BLIS K12 for the mouth", a pink stomach icon "Gut support inside".
